responsibility: Implements Motorola 68000 ABI classification by returning aggregates indirectly, passing aggregate arguments via fixed stack slots, and extending scalar integers to 32 bits.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/m68k.rs`, this M68k file is about call ABI lowering—especially indirect returns, byval stack-passed aggregates, and 32-bit integer extension—not inline-assembly register classes or reserved-register handling.
